title: Internal vs external action routing audit
executive_summary: Gravitre does not use one governed execution pipeline for all chat-originated writes. External connector writes reunify through react_write_gate + ChatConnectorExecutionService (plan → risk → confirm → invoke_tool + audit). Internal/platform writes split across ConversationalExecutionService, ReAct assistant_* tools (explicitly exempt from react_write_gate), and REST pack install — with no catalog authority, inconsistent risk evaluation, and no tool.invoke.* audit on direct DB/API writes.

remediation_themes: Unify write taxonomy: assistant_create/execute_workflow and assistant_run_agent_task as governed writes
Extend react_write_gate or add platform_write_gate for assistant_* and optionally MCP
Route platform writes through invoke_tool or parallel audited executor
Collapse pending_task schemas to one envelope
Parent confirm before nested agent delegation; propagate blocked writes to parent pending_task
MCP catalog-tier parity with connector write authority
